name: @evs/orchestrator
description: Autoscaler: reaps stale claims and launches EC2 Spot workers from the queue backlog. Runs as a scheduled Lambda or as a local loop.

scripts.build: esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/lambda/index.js --external:@aws-sdk/* --external:pg-native && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/lambda/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && esbuild src/local.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/local.js --external:pg-native --sourcemap --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
